summary: Frontend-only testing of the provisional 'Coming Soon EN' pop-up on 5 Citadelle content pages (blog, blog post, chroniques, guides, parutions). All requested scenarios pass: absent in FR, present in EN with correct title/body/CTA, closes via CTA/X/overlay, re-appears on every navigation without localStorage memoization, and regression back to FR removes it.
critical_code_review_comments: ComingSoonEnModal.jsx: the close 'X' button uses position:relative + float:right which is a fragile pattern; it works but should ideally be position:absolute inside a positioned container. Minor cosmetic concern only.

Modal re-shows on every mount because state is initialized from i18n.language on each page mount — intended per requirement, but note this means it re-appears also on client-side route transitions where the layout unmounts. Confirmed working as desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature 'coming-soon-en' pop-up validated end-to-end. data-testids: coming-soon-en-modal / -overlay / -close / -cta. lang-switcher toggles i18n + localStorage 'citadelle_lang'. Modal is intentionally NOT memoized (no dismiss key stored). Tested via https://code-syndicate-2.preview.emergentagent.com on /citadelle/blog, /citadelle/blog/comment-vendre-une-boutique-prestashop, /citadelle/chroniques, /citadelle/guides, /citadelle/parutions.
